widget_types.description: Interactive card that flips 180 degrees upon tap to reveal the evidence-based medical fact behind common health misconceptions.
widget_types.user_experience_goal: Eliminates boring static reading by turning common myths into interactive discovery moments.

widget_types.description: Short 1-question check-in embedded midway through an article to test comprehension and retain critical health facts.
widget_types.user_experience_goal: Gamifies learning and increases reading retention by 40%.

widget_types.description: Visual step-by-step progress stepper with built-in interactive stopwatch/timer (e.g. 20-min burn cool down, 3-sec EpiPen hold).
widget_types.user_experience_goal: Provides real-time utility in high-stress emergency situations.

widget_types.description: Sliding input controls allowing users to calculate personal metrics like daily water intake based on body weight or sleep debt score.
widget_types.user_experience_goal: Makes health advice personalized and actionable.
